review_candidates.description: [무신사 테크 ​소개] 팀 ​무신사 ​테크 조직은 ​혁신의 원동력이자 변화를 선도하는 ​핵심 ​기술 조직입니다. ​고객과 입점 브랜드가 ​각자의 고유한 ​개성을 ​자유롭게 표현할 ​수 ​있도록, ​데이터와 기술을 기반으로 ​한 ​개인화된 경험을 제공합니다. ​무신사 ​테크는 ​새로운 도전을 두려워하지 ​않으며, 항상 ​새로운 ​영역에서의 성공을 ​꿈꿉니다. 무신사는 ​한국을 ​넘어 글로벌 시장에서도 ​경쟁력 있는 ​서비스를 선보이고자 OCMP(One Core Multi Platform) 를 구축하고 있습니다. 이를 통해 전체 비즈니스의 폭발적 성장을 지원하며 무신사 테크는 끊임없는 도전과 혁신으로 고객에게 더 나은 가치를 제공하고자 합니다. 무신사 테크 블로그 29CM 테크 블로그 테크 유튜브 채널 무신사 링크드인 MUSINSA TECH [조직 소개] IT Security 조직은 “정보보안-기술”, “정보보안-정책”으로 구성되어 있습니다. 각 정보보안 영역에서 전문성을 가진 동료들이 모여, 팀 무신사 서비스 및 고객님들의 정보를 안전하게 지키고 있습니다. You will be the on-the-ground IT presence for our team members, supporting a broad range of users, devices, systems and operational technologies. You will diagnose and resolve incidents, fulfil service requests, manage IT assets, maintain accurate support documentation and work closely with internal technology teams and external suppliers. This role is fully office-based and requires the successful candidate to work from the Fulfilment Centre (Yennora) and/or our Headquarters (Barangaroo) five days per week. This is essential to provide timely, hands-on support for staff, devices, printers, meeting spaces and operational technology. **Key Responsibilities** *Customer Support and Service Delivery* Deliver professional, responsive and customer-focused IT support to internal business customers Act as a visible, approachable and reliable on-site IT support contact for operational and corporate users Receive, log, prioritise, investigate and resolve incidents and service requests through the approved ticketing system Ensure all support activities, troubleshooting steps, customer communications and resolutions are accurately documented *Technical Support and Troubleshooting* Diagnose and resolve technical issues across hardware, software, operating systems, applications and user access Provide support for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, barcode scanners, printers and audio-visual equipment Install, configure, maintain and replace IT equipment, meeting room technology and collaboration tools Perform basic network troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi, VPN, connectivity and device access issues, escalating where required *Systems, Asset and Supplier Management* Maintain accurate records of IT hardware, software and assets, including stock, allocation, returns, replacements and lifecycle activities Support onboarding, offboarding and employee moves by preparing, recovering and updating devices and access Liaise with suppliers and service providers, tracking activities and outcomes to ensure issues are resolved and customers remain informed *Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement* Create, maintain and improve knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides and technical documentation Document known errors, workarounds, solutions and recurring issues to improve first-contact resolution and reduce repeat incidents Identify trends in incidents, service requests and user feedback, escalating opportunities for service improvement **Skills and Experience** *Essential Experience And Attributes* 1–3 years' experience in an IT support, service desk, desktop support or similar technical support role Experience working with a service desk or ticketing system Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise work in a busy environment Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users Willingness to travel between hub locations (Yennora and Barangaroo) *Technical Experience* The successful candidate will have experience supporting, or exposure to, a range of end-user technologies and enterprise IT services, including: Service desk and IT service management platforms, including Jira and Jira Service Management (JSM) Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Windows Server and Active Directory fundamentals Apple MacOS, iOS, Android, endpoint management and identity/access management platforms such as Okta Hardware, asset management, audio-visual and video conferencing support across laptops, desktops, printers, peripherals and mobile devices Basic networking concepts and troubleshooting, including Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, connectivity and IP addressing *Desirable Experience* The following experience is highly regarded and will be considered a strong advantage: Microsoft Intune for device management, application deployment and endpoint compliance Jamf Pro administration and support for Apple devices Experience with printing solutions, label printers, handheld devices, scanners or warehouse-related technology Exposure to asset management platforms and hardware lifecycle management Understanding of Microsoft Active Directory, group policies and endpoint configuration Experience working with third-party suppliers and managed service providers **Life at this fashion ecommerce company** From our ways of working to our growth mindset and sustainable approach, we each add unique value and have an incredible amount of fun doing it! People are our greatest asset and our employee experience is designed to empower you to do your best work. Here's what to expect when you join us: **The learning collective.** Get your knowledge fix with our learning days, hackathons & LinkedIn Learning **Parents with us.** Access to our parental leave program and an extra day off for your kids' first day of school every year **Birthday leave.** Enjoy a paid day off for your birthday and a company voucher to treat yourself **Curate your style.** No matter what your style is, we have got you covered with our amazing staff discount and our famous sample sales **Wellbeing.** Access to our Fitness Passport and our company wellbeing programs **People first.** Access to our Employee Assistance Program for you and your family **Volunteer days.** Work as a Charity Partner with Thread Together for society and environmental change We are committed to providing reasonable arrangements to all individuals participating in our application and interview process, and while performing job functions. If you require any accommodations or adjustments prior to the submission of your application or throughout your interview process, please contact our Talent Acquisition team directly By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of this company's Candidate Privacy Policy. 🟢 Please consider applying even if you don't meet 100% of what's outlined 🟢 **Key Responsibilities** 👥 Providing customer support 🔍 Diagnosing technical issues 📊 Managing IT assets **Key Strengths** 🤝 Customer support 🛠️ Technical troubleshooting 📝 Documentation 🌐 Network troubleshooting 📦 Asset management 📚 Knowledge management Why this company is partnering with Hatch on this role: Hatch exists to level the playing field for people as they discover a career that's right for them. So when you apply, you have the chance to show more than just your resume. *A Final Note: This is a role with this company, not with Hatch.* Compensation & Benefits salary not disclosed +staff discount apply on career site → opens the brand's careers page in a new tab.
